name: cavemio-alert
title: Alert
description: A message that sits in the page: its tint, line and icon ease when the tone changes, and dismissing folds it away so the content below slides up.

cavemio.usage:
import { Alert } from "@/components/alert";

<Alert tone="warning" title="Your card expires on 30 November" action={<button>Update</button>} onDismiss={() => {}}>
  Update it to keep All access.
</Alert>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Reduced motion: changes and dismissal happen in place.
- Folded alerts are inert, so focus can't land in them.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: – · Shows ✕; called after it has folded.

useCases.title: Billing
useCases.description: A card is about to expire, with Update.

useCases.title: Forms
useCases.description: A summary of what needs fixing.

useCases.title: Announcements
useCases.description: A dismissible note at the top of a settings page.

features.title: Folding dismissal
features.description: Height closes (380ms, 80ms after the fade) so content slides up.

features.title: Right role
features.description: role="alert" for warning and danger, "status" otherwise.

features.title: Responsive action
features.description: Beside the text on wide cards, under it on narrow ones.

states.title: tone change
states.description: Background, line and icon colour ease; the icon swaps through a 3px blur.

states.title: dismiss
states.description: Lifts 6px and fades (220ms) while the height folds (380ms).
